name: Coding Jobs (Qwen Code)

meta.description: Start, track and cancel unattended coding jobs. Each job runs Qwen Code on the local model local-deep against a git clone on the server, on a new branch qwen/<job-id>, runs the tests and commits the result for review. Talks to the coding-agent service; nothing is pushed.
